label: Complement of the observation
title: The complement of the observation always closes, but the residual class is not its equivalence class
kind: Exact audit of three non-linear observations with an observational-equivalence census and a depth annex
summary: For observations 32, 200 and 22 the complement rule closes and lies in the residual class of closed rules with a non-constant factor that is not the rule, as frozen. The frozen prediction that every residual rule is observationally equivalent to the complement rule failed for 32 and 200. Observational equivalence is decided by five-cell words and is ring-independent, which certifies the ninth unit's rule-123 identity for every ring. Majority's record depth grows to 31 at ring 16.
takeaway: The construction generalizes and the equivalence does not: closure under an observation splits into commuters, collapses, and a residual whose only guaranteed member is the complement of the observation.
